title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4WEAR - MemoryStorage
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4wear/MemoryStorage. A hardware component intended to store data within the device (ETSI TS 103 410-9 clause 4.2.7). The SAREF4WEAR ontology defines this class only as the range of an object property (it declares no own datatype property); the attributes below are reasonable, minimal descriptive fields added for a usable candidate model and are not themselves drawn from explicit ontology axioms.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'MemoryStorage'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

storageCapacity.description: Property. Storage capacity of the component, in MB.

storageType.description: Property. Open-vocabulary kind of storage medium, e.g. 'flash', 'eMMC'.
